description: Convert XML to a structured, ordered node representation in JSON, or rebuild XML from that representation. Attributes and mixed text remain explicit. UTF-8 input up to 32 MiB. DTDs and external entities are rejected. JSON-to-XML requires this tool’s node schema; arbitrary JSON has no unique XML mapping. XML declarations, comments and processing instructions are not preserved. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: xml_json
title: Convert XML and JSON
